title: feat(build): avoid overly strict babel helpers
body:
**Summary**

Make the bundlesize slightly smaller by optimising the babel options

**Result**

Since we don't use the cases presented in those plugins as far as I can see (spreading non-iterables, symbols...)

Impact:

* 1.4KB~ for everything loose
* .6KB~ for only the specified transforms

Closes #4639, #4640, #4644
